name: Vehicle versions and checkout prices update together
covers: Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Roadster and Semi variant selection
selected version and price shown in checkout
description: Select multiple vehicle versions and confirm the selected version and exact management-provided price are shown in the checkout summary and enquiry.
steps: Open Shop and select Model Y
Choose Model Y Performance
Confirm $57,990 appears as the selected vehicle price and in checkout
Choose Roadster Rocket and confirm Invite only is shown
Open Cybertruck and select Cyberbeast; confirm $102,490 is shown
expected: Each selected version updates the preview and checkout price; lease pricing appears where supplied and Roadster Rocket is marked Invite only.

name: Customer chat has one management identity and a compact readable layout
covers: single Tesla Markets Management chat header
verified badge and replaceable profile picture
chat message send and scroll behavior
description: Open the customer chat and verify the management identity is shown once with the verified badge and profile image, and message text is readable.
steps: Open Contact / customer chat
Check that only one Tesla Markets Management identity is displayed with the verified badge
Send a short message
Scroll up to read the earlier welcome message without being pulled to the bottom
expected: The chat shows one compact management header, normal-sized message text, and lets the visitor browse message history.

name: Admin dashboard shows activity and allows profile picture replacement
covers: admin profile picture upload and persistence
description: Sign in as the authorised administrator and use the management workspace.
steps: Sign in with the authorised management account
Open Overview and inspect page views, online now, chats and messages
Open Settings and upload a valid profile picture
Save it and confirm the preview shows the newly saved picture
Open Chats & replies and open a recent customer conversation
expected: The private admin dashboard shows current activity metrics and recent chats, and the saved management picture is returned by the persistent profile endpoint.

name: Investment enquiry opens chat without a portfolio
covers: investment page has no portfolio balances or gains
Invest Now opens internal management chat
description: Verify the revised investment enquiry journey.
steps: Open Investments
Confirm the page shows Tesla investment information and Broker connected
Confirm there are no portfolio values, gains or rate panels
Tap Invest Now
expected: The investment page contains no portfolio display and Invest Now opens the internal Tesla Markets Management chat.

name: Navigation back button returns to previous page or home
description: Move through several site pages and use back navigation.
steps: Open Investments from the homepage
Open Shop
Use the page Back control
Open a vehicle page and use All vehicles
Open a page directly with no in-app history and use Back
expected: Back returns to the actual previous page, and direct-entry navigation falls back to the homepage without looping.
